Wonderful Buffet and Professional Staff
Sep 2026 • Family
We traveled as a family staying 7 days at JW Marriott hotel in Hanoi. Though we had access to the executive lounge, we mainly dined at JW cafe for breakfast as they had much more varied options to choose from and the familiar faces of the dining hall staff were very much welcomed. 

The dining hall itself overlooks the waters that look especially beautiful at sunrise. The ambience and decor is beautiful and of first class quality. 

The food itself was fantastic serving a variety of international cuisine. There was Indian food, Omlette station, Sushi rolls and miso soup, Korean ramyun and kimchi stew section, Cold Vietnamese salads, Pho and banh cuon/bun cha section as well as a pastry section with a variety of yogurts, bread and fruits. Soufflé pancakes deserves its own praise, as well as the Vietnamese coffee/salted coffee that they are able to make for you at the round bar. 

The dining hall staff is what makes JW Cafe really shine. We couldn’t help but notice how charismatic, engaging yet professional the staff were. Our servers Mai Huong, Phuong Quyen and Ahn Duong were particularly friendly and enthusiastic especially when engaging with our 3 year old toddler. As a mother, even the smallest acts of kindness and goodwill gestures absolutely do not go unnoticed. They even prepared a special surprise on our last day in Hanoi which was heartwarming and full of good feelings. 

Having been to many different Marriot properties and their respective dining halls in many different parts of the world, I am thoroughly impressed by the level of Vietnamese hospitality and standard of service the staff here present. We would definitely come back when coming back to Hanoi!
